reuse.why: Adds the option to the existing getMonthActionCategories selection that all month-wide actions already use.

duplication.why: No logic repeated; a shared MonthActionArgs type even removes the per-action argument type copies.

placement.why: The hidden rule stays in the shared selection function in budget/actions.ts.

scope.why: Only the selection, the action signatures and one test.

maintainability.why: One function owns which categories are filled, with the new variation as an explicit parameter and an updated comment.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six month-wide actions pass the flag to getMonthActionCategories.
